0.original: You needn't be an entelechy to feel the weight bearing down on Hermes.

24.original: Speak with Meteion and have her accompany you.

25.original: Examine flowers at the Twelve Wonders while accompanied by Meteion.

26.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

27.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

28.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

29.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

30.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

31.original: Look for flowers while accompanied by Meteion.

49.original: I fear this discussion may take a while, during which time...

51.original: It's not me, Hermes. It's you...

52.original: I won't go to the meeting. I'll stay with <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

53.original: Loath though I am to impose, may I leave Meteion in your care again?

54.original: I'm in your debt. If you'll excuse me...

55.original: Can you help me with something, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

56.original: The meeting will make Hermes sad. I want to cheer him up. With a flower.

57.original: Hermes likes flowers the most. Of all the creations in Elpis.

58.original: Most creations are expected to be interesting. Or beautiful. Or strong. Better in some way.

59.original: But flowers are different. They're designed to suit our emotions. What we feel and want to convey. Hermes likes that.

60.original: I can't make flowers. So I'll search for one. And I want you to search with me.

61.original: Let's start here. At the Twelve Wonders.

62.original: Meteion is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.

63.original: You can leave Meteion behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.

64.original: If you wish to have Meteion accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.

69.original: Let's search the Twelve Wonders first.

70.original: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Meteion?

71.original: All right! I'll wait at the building.

72.original: Hermes is still talking. We still have time!

73.original: Meteion has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before you examine the flowers.

74.original: You should have Meteion accompanying you before you examine the flowers.

75.original: Vibrant purple flowers bigger than your hands adorn the tree.

76.original: Oooh, so big and bright! I love them!

77.original: ...But they might be too bright. You have to think of the recipient. That's what Hermes said.

78.original: Let's head outside next. Don't worry─we won't wander far.

79.original: A tall, slender tree rises before you. You crane your neck to look for flowers.

80.original: No flowers... If there were apples, we could've covered them in syrup...

81.original: Let's head outside next. Don't worry─we won't wander far.

82.original: Lots of flowers in the fields. We should be able to find something nice!

83.original: You should have Meteion accompanying you before you look for flowers.

84.original: An array of beautiful flowers grow in the bed, their mix of colors forming a pattern.

85.original: These would be better for Hermes...but they're hedged in.

86.original: That means we shouldn't touch them. They're either under observation or poisonous.

87.original: Any other place should be fine, though. Let's keep looking!

88.original: Vibrant or subdued...? Interesting or plain...? Hmmm...

89.original: Set on a tall, thin stalk, the oddly shaped flower is mesmerizing in its undulations...

90.original: Oh, a coneion! A flower that can move!

91.original: When Hermes wasn't looking, it shot seeds at him. Not a good gift, maybe...

92.original: But you're good, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─at spotting flowers! We'll find something soon!

93.original: You're good at observing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Just like an observer!

94.original: You spy nothing promising nearby. At best, common-looking grasses with some few tiny flowers...

97.original: Come on, let's get closer! But not too close!

98.original: A terrible stench reminiscent of sodden old boots pervades the air... Without a doubt, the culprit is the morbol-like creature before you.

99.original: It's an adonis! The things around its mouth look like petals. But the flowers are the orbs on its head!

100.original: When Hermes inspected it, it swallowed him up. He didn't leave his room for days. What do you think, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Would he like it?

102.original: It's probably not the good sort of memory...

103.original: I'd rather not go near that thing...

105.original: Finding a good flower... It's harder than I thought.

106.original: I'm sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but could we search a little more? Maybe as far as the fields over there. I'll pick something after that, I promise.

107.original: I've never given a gift before... Were you nervous too? For your first time?

108.original: Lush, green fields stretch out before you, ending where the sky begins...

110.original: ...Hm? The shiny thing over there. What could it be?

111.original: I learned something new recently─the meaning of Philomythes Notos!

112.original: “Notos” is a south wind person...and “Philomythes” is his joy! Why is he joyful? Because this place is so beautiful!

113.original: Ooh, Elpis flowers! They're here too!

114.original: Hermes likes and dislikes them. At the same time.

115.original: Like me, they're entelechies. Like me, they feel his pain and turn dark...

116.original: That's only for Hermes, though. For others, they're always white and bright.

117.original: Truly!? The flower was dark in your home!?

118.original: Then...do you have it too? A dark emotion?

120.original: I've known the pain and sorrow of loss.

121.original: I've felt great fury and frustration.

122.original: I've been plagued by doubt and anxiety.

123.original: I daresay I have a few.

125.original: Hermes has known the same. The feeling that a part of you is gone. Again and again. But no one notices...

126.original: Please, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Won't you lend it to me? Your pain and sorrow...

128.original: Hermes has felt the same. A fire burning in your breast. A trembling hand. But no one understands...

129.original: Please, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Won't you lend them to me? Your fury and frustration...

131.original: Hermes has felt the same. A shortness of breath. The walls closer and closer. But only him. No one else feels it...

132.original: Please, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Won't you lend them to me? Your doubt and anxiety...

133.original: You don't have to say it. I can feel it's something you want to hide.

134.original: But won't you lend it to me? The darkness inside you?

135.original: I want you to make the flower dark. In front of Hermes.

136.original: He has been in a dark place. Since before he created me. He needs to know that he isn't there alone. That others are sad too.

138.original: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Thank you! It means more to me than I can say!

139.original: I can't wait to see how Hermes reacts! Let's go back and fetch him!

140.original: It seems they're still talking. Let's wait until they've finished.
